dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary features include multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-intensity light-grey perimeters. The edges show a high-frequency, serrated geometry with a sharp gradient transition to dark-grey/black internal zones, particularly prominent in the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of small, saturated high-intensity pixel clusters is visible in the anterior-cervical region and scattered along the lower ventral-lateral flank, characterized by solid core concentrations lacking internal textural gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface define an elongated scalene triangle with its longest axis roughly parallel to the spinal column.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast 'V' shaped linear feature is visible on the posterior-lateral flank, distinct from the surrounding closed-loop annuli structures.
